title: 第21章 烈阳圣地第22章 突破天元境
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【你将在秘境中获得的玄级上品武技《大慈大悲掌》交给了江长天，让其进行复印留一册在雪山派，此后雪山派真传弟子花费贡献都可以学习，你在雪山派的地位提升了，你获得了一笔大量的门派贡献。
同时因为大慈大悲掌与千山雪不同，是你个人所获，你在记录下武技后，将原本交给了父亲叶昌明带回叶家。
【同年，你服用了地级上品的涅盘宝丹。
你的根骨从玄级中品提升到地级下品。
你服用了地元宝丹，的境界突破到地元境初期。
虽然突破到地元境后你无法再次进入小福地，但有着传承的加成，以及地级下品根骨，你自信你修炼的速度只会比此前更快。
【第三十三年，你的武技大慈大悲掌提升到初窥门径，同时你的儿女们在这一年成婚。
【第三十四年，你的妻子江雯为你生下了第三个孩子，这个孩子受到了九龙丹的庇护，出生时伴随祥瑞天象，出生之日周围出现五彩霞光环绕，小儿子的根骨达到了地级中品，特殊体质无法探测出为何体质，你给小儿子取名为叶辰。
【同年，因为你的实力已经不弱于天元境，你将记忆中处于宜城附近的一些秘境，只要是你能够轻松拿捏的普通秘境，你都进行了搜刮，获得了一笔不错的资源。
【第三十五年，你的领悟了大成千山刀意，你的玄级下品武技千山雪达到了登峰造极。
你的玄级上品武技大慈大悲掌提升到了登堂入室，你画出了第一幅黄级上品画作。
你将千山雪的百世玉简留在了雪山派，你获得了一笔门派贡献，再次提升了你在雪山派的地位。
【同年，你的孙子出生，你的孩子给他取名为叶尘，根骨检测出为玄级中品，并无特殊体质与天赋。
同时，这一年你的妻子江雯成为了雪山派当代掌门，因为你的原因，叶家很多嫡系弟子也加入了雪山派，你的大儿子叶平安因为从小被他爷爷叶昌明带大，所以对于叶家的感情更加深厚，这也是你有意为之，因为有着玄级上品根骨的原因，已经被叶家当做下代家族进行培养。
你的女儿则大多数时间都留在雪山派，与外曾祖母柳如丝相处的时间更长，所以与柳如丝更加亲近。
【第三十六年，萍城地区出现贼患，屠戮了好几个小型城镇，萍城势力在竭力围捕。
【第三十七年，贼患首领被斩杀，其余贼众逃出不少，向着其他方向四处逃窜。
【第三十八年，你的境界提升到地元境中期，你的大慈大悲掌提升到登堂入室境界。
content_en:
[You gave Jiang Changtian the Xuan-level high-grade martial art "Great Compassionate Palm" obtained in the secret realm, and asked him to make a copy and keep a copy in the Snow Mountain Sect. After that, the true disciples of the Snow Mountain Sect can learn it by spending their contribution. Your status in the Snow Mountain Sect has been improved, and you have received a large amount of contribution to the sect.
At the same time, because the Great Compassionate Palm is different from Qianshan Snow, it was obtained by you personally. After recording the martial arts, you gave the copy to your father Ye Changming and took it back to the Ye family.
[In the same year, you took the top-grade Nirvana Pill.
Your root bone has been upgraded from the middle level of Xuan level to the low level of Earth level.
You took the Earth Yuan Treasure Pill and your realm broke through to the early stage of the Earth Yuan Realm.
Although you cannot enter the Little Blessed Land again after breaking through to the Earth Element Realm, with the bonus of inheritance and the Earth-level low-grade root bones, you are confident that your cultivation speed will only be faster than before.
[In the thirty-third year, your martial arts skills, Great Mercy and Compassionate Palm, have been improved to the first level. At the same time, your children will get married in this year.
[In the thirty-fourth year, your wife Jiang Wen gave birth to your third child. This child was protected by the Nine Dragon Pill. He was born with auspicious celestial phenomena. On the day of his birth, he was surrounded by colorful rays of light. The younger son’s bones reached the prefecture-level mid-level. His special constitution cannot be detected. You named your younger son Ye Chen.
[In the same year, because your strength is no longer weaker than Tianyuan Realm, you will remember some secret realms near Yicheng. As long as they are ordinary secret realms that you can easily handle, you have searched them and obtained a good amount of resources.
[In the thirty-fifth year, you have comprehended the Dacheng Qianshan Sword Intent, and your Xuan-level low-grade martial arts Qianshanxue has reached its peak.
Your Xuan-level high-grade martial art, Great Mercy and Great Compassion Palm, was upgraded to the level of entering the hall, and you painted your first yellow-level high-grade painting.
You left Qianshanxue's Eternal Jade Slip in the Snow Mountain Sect, and you received a contribution to the sect, which once again enhanced your status in the Snow Mountain Sect.
[In the same year, your grandson was born, and your child named him Ye Chen. His root bones were detected to be mid-grade Xuan level, and he had no special physique or talent.
At the same time, this year your wife Jiang Wen became the current head of the Snow Mountain Sect. Because of you, many direct disciples of the Ye family also joined the Snow Mountain sect. Your eldest son Ye Pingan was brought up by his grandfather Ye Changming, so he has a deeper affection for the Ye family. This was also your intention. Because he has the foundation of a high-grade Xuan level, he has been cultivated by the Ye family as the next generation of the family.
Your daughter stayed in the Snow Mountain Sect most of the time and spent more time with her maternal great-grandmother Liu Rusi, so she was closer to Liu Rusi.
[In the thirty-sixth year, thieves appeared in the Pingcheng area and several small towns were massacred. Pingcheng forces were trying their best to round them up.
[In the thirty-seventh year, the leader of the thieves was beheaded, and many of the remaining thieves fled in other directions.
[In the thirty-eighth year, your realm has been raised to the middle stage of the Earth Element Realm, and your Great Mercy and Compassionate Palm has been raised to the realm of entering the palace.
